proposals.name: previous_plan_temporal_consistency_source_v1
proposals.runtime_definition: For candidate k at tick t, align the previous tick's selected planned trajectory after one simulator step with the current candidate horizon, then compute a finite nonnegative L2/RMS deviation over matched ego poses. If no previous selected plan exists, the source must fail closed or emit a documented neutral default before any selector promotion.
non_equivalence_evidence: not DP Top-1 retention because the reference is the previous selected plan state, not the current DP ranking
not route/progress/lane-hard because it measures temporal plan continuity against prior selector memory, not map progress or lane relation
not candidate-set shape support because it compares each candidate to the prior selected trajectory, not to the current candidate ensemble distribution
not postprocess/tracker distortion because it does not compare raw and postprocessed versions of the same candidate
not traffic-signal or external-context because it uses no signal phase, right-of-way, or future outcome labels
proposals.rationale: Industrial planners often need temporal hysteresis to avoid candidate flicker. This source is current-tick, finite-candidate, nonnegative, and stateful only through previously selected planning output already known before current selection. Once atomized as a fixed coefficient a_k, CAMP scoring remains affine score_k(w)=a_k^T w and the simplex/CVaR/L2 master remains convex. This proposal only authorizes a default-off payload design gate, not replay, training, online selector promotion, Full36, formal seeds, DP modification, or a DP-side classical Benders claim.
